```{r setup}
job_dir <- params$job_dir
stopifnot(nzchar(job_dir), dir.exists(job_dir))
ctx <- params$report_ctx

# Fallback if ctx not provided (should not happen in Phase 8).
if (is.null(ctx) || !is.list(ctx) || is.null(ctx$paths) || is.null(ctx$exists)) {
  ctx <- list(
    job_dir = job_dir,
    paths = list(),
    exists = list()
  )
}

safe_read_csv <- function(path) {
  if (is.null(path) || !is.character(path) || length(path) != 1) return(NULL)
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
}

safe_read_json <- function(path) {
  if (is.null(path) || !is.character(path) || length(path) != 1) return(NULL)
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(jsonlite::read_json(path, simplifyVector = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
}

safe_include_graphics <- function(path) {
  if (is.null(path) || !is.character(path) || length(path) != 1) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(invisible(NULL))
  knitr::include_graphics(path)
}

safe_include_md <- function(path) {
  if (is.null(path) || !is.character(path) || length(path) != 1) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(invisible(NULL))
  lines <- tryCatch(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(lines) || length(lines) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  # Avoid duplicated headings when the template already provides section titles.
  first <- trimws(lines[[1]])
  if (grepl("^#{1,6}\\s+Methods\\s*$", first, ignore.case = TRUE)) lines <- lines[-1]
  if (grepl("^#{1,6}\\s+Figure\\s+Legends\\s*$", first, ignore.case = TRUE)) lines <- lines[-1]
  txt <- paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
  if (is.null(txt) || !nzchar(txt)) return(invisible(NULL))
  cat(txt, "\n")
}

safe_include_md_demote_h1 <- function(path) {
  if (is.null(path) || !is.character(path) || length(path) != 1) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(invisible(NULL))
  lines <- tryCatch(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(lines) || length(lines) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  # Demote level-1 headings for readability inside report sections.
  lines <- sub("^#\\s+", "### ", lines)

  # Guardrail: do not allow unrelated sections to appear under differential interpretation.
  bad_head <- grepl("^#{1,6}\\s+(Machine Learning|Network|Co-?occurrence Network|Key Taxa Score)\\b", lines, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (any(bad_head)) {
    keep <- rep(TRUE, length(lines))
    drop_from <- which(bad_head)[1]
    keep[drop_from:length(lines)] <- FALSE
    lines <- lines[keep]
  }

  txt <- paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
  if (!nzchar(txt)) return(invisible(NULL))
  cat(txt, "\n")
}

fmt_kv <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return("(missing)")
  if (length(x) == 0) return("(missing)")
  paste0(x, collapse = ", ")
}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x
}

beta_slugify <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x %||% "bray")))
  gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", x)
}

display_taxon <- function(x) {
  # Display-only: show the last non-empty taxonomic rank; keep original strings for joins.
  if (is.null(x)) return(character(0))
  x <- as.character(x)
  vapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return(NA_character_)
    s <- trimws(s)
    if (!nzchar(s)) return(s)
    parts <- strsplit(s, "\\|")[[1]]
    parts <- trimws(parts)
    parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
    if (length(parts) == 0) s else parts[[length(parts)]]
  }, character(1))
}
```

This report is generated by **Microbiome Key Taxa AI**.

## Project Overview

This is an integrated, reproducible HTML report summarizing results from:
Alpha/Beta diversity, differential abundance, AI-constrained interpretation,
machine learning screening, co-occurrence network analysis, and the final Key Taxa Score.

## Executive Summary

```{r}
ml_sum <- safe_read_json(ctx$paths$json$ml_summary %||% file.path(job_dir, "json", "ml_summary.json"))
net_sum <- safe_read_json(ctx$paths$json$network_summary %||% file.path(job_dir, "json", "network_summary.json"))

alpha_path <- ctx$paths$tables$alpha_diversity %||% file.path(job_dir, "tables", "alpha_diversity.csv")
alpha <- safe_read_csv(alpha_path)

sig_path <- ctx$paths$tables$differential_taxa_significant %||% file.path(job_dir, "tables", "differential_taxa_significant.csv")
sig <- safe_read_csv(sig_path)

top20_path <- ctx$paths$tables$key_taxa_top20 %||% file.path(job_dir, "tables", "key_taxa_top20.csv")
top20 <- safe_read_csv(top20_path)

repro_gv <- if (is.list(ctx$reproducibility) && is.list(ctx$reproducibility$parameters) && !is.null(ctx$reproducibility$parameters$group_var)) as.character(ctx$reproducibility$parameters$group_var) else NA_character_
n_samples <- if (is.list(ml_sum) && !is.null(ml_sum$n_samples)) as.integer(ml_sum$n_samples) else if (is.data.frame(alpha)) nrow(alpha) else NA_integer_
n_features <- if (is.list(ml_sum) && !is.null(ml_sum$n_features)) as.integer(ml_sum$n_features) else NA_integer_
group_var <- if (!is.na(repro_gv) && nzchar(repro_gv)) repro_gv else if (is.list(ml_sum) && !is.null(ml_sum$group_variable)) as.character(ml_sum$group_variable) else NA_character_
n_sig <- if (is.data.frame(sig)) nrow(sig) else 0L
ml_rel <- if (is.list(ml_sum) && !is.null(ml_sum$reliability)) as.character(ml_sum$reliability) else "(unavailable)"
net_edges <- if (is.list(net_sum) && !is.null(net_sum$n_edges)) as.integer(net_sum$n_edges) else NA_integer_

group_counts <- NULL
if (is.data.frame(alpha) && is.character(group_var) && nzchar(group_var) && group_var %in% names(alpha)) {
  group_counts <- sort(table(alpha[[group_var]]), decreasing = TRUE)
}

top_taxa <- NULL
if (is.data.frame(top20) && nrow(top20) > 0 && "taxon" %in% names(top20)) {
  top_taxa <- unique(display_taxon(top20$taxon))
  top_taxa <- top_taxa[!is.na(top_taxa) & nzchar(top_taxa)]
  top_taxa <- head(top_taxa, 5)
}

summary_rows <- data.frame(
  item = c(
    "Samples",
    "Features (Genus level for ML)",
    "Group variable",
    "Significant taxa (differential analysis)",
    "ML reliability",
    "Network edges",
    "Top candidate key taxa"
  ),
  value = c(
    ifelse(is.na(n_samples), "(unavailable)", n_samples),
    ifelse(is.na(n_features), "(unavailable)", n_features),
    ifelse(is.na(group_var) || !nzchar(group_var), "(unavailable)", group_var),
    n_sig,
    ml_rel,
    ifelse(is.na(net_edges), "(unavailable)", net_edges),
    if (is.null(top_taxa) || length(top_taxa) == 0) "(unavailable)" else paste(top_taxa, collapse = ", ")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(summary_rows, col.names = c("Item", "Value"))

if (!is.null(group_counts)) {
  cat("\n\n**Group sample counts:**\n\n")
  knitr::kable(data.frame(group = names(group_counts), n = as.integer(group_counts), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}
```

```{r}
n_features <- if (is.list(ml_sum) && !is.null(ml_sum$n_features)) as.integer(ml_sum$n_features) else NA_integer_
group_var <- if (!is.na(repro_gv) && nzchar(repro_gv)) repro_gv else if (is.list(ml_sum) && !is.null(ml_sum$group_variable)) as.character(ml_sum$group_variable) else NA_character_

group_counts <- NULL

overview <- data.frame(

)
knitr::kable(overview, col.names = c("Field", "Value"), caption = "Dataset overview")

if (!is.null(group_counts)) {

    data.frame(group = names(group_counts), n = as.integer(group_counts), stringsAsFactors = FALSE),

if (is.null(checks)) {

} else if (!is.data.frame(checks) || nrow(checks) < 1) {
  cat("\n\nUnavailable: data_check_summary.csv is empty.\n")
} else {
  # Basic status summary if available.
  if ("status" %in% names(checks)) {

    knitr::kable(

}
```

## Methods

### Alpha/Beta Diversity

Alpha diversity indices are computed per sample and compared between groups when a group variable is provided. Beta diversity is summarized from the saved job outputs, including distance-matrix ordination, PERMANOVA, beta dispersion, NMDS, pairwise distance structure, and ANOSIM.

### Differential Abundance Analysis

Differential abundance identifies taxa associated with the group variable. Multiple-testing correction is applied (FDR). Results are descriptive and should be interpreted with study design context.

### Machine Learning (Random Forest)

Random Forest is used as a screening tool to rank taxa by importance for distinguishing groups. When sample size is small, results are treated as exploratory.

### Co-occurrence Network

A Spearman correlation network is built from genus-level abundances using correlation and FDR thresholds. Co-occurrence reflects correlation patterns and does not imply direct interaction.

### Key Taxa Score

KeyTaxaScore integrates available evidence sources (differential, ML importance, and network centrality) using weighted, normalized components. If a taxon lacks one evidence source, the score is computed from the remaining available evidence for that taxon and marked as exploratory via the evidence fields.

### AI Interpretation

This report includes pre-generated AI interpretation text when available. Phase 8 does not call any LLM API during report rendering.

## Differential Abundance Analysis

```{r}
diff_path <- ctx$paths$tables$differential_taxa %||% file.path(job_dir, "tables", "differential_taxa.csv")
diff <- safe_read_csv(diff_path)
diff_summary_path <- ctx$paths$json$diff_summary %||% file.path(job_dir, "json", "diff_summary.json")
diff_summary <- safe_read_json(diff_summary_path)
sig_path <- ctx$paths$tables$differential_taxa_significant %||% file.path(job_dir, "tables", "differential_taxa_significant.csv")
sig <- safe_read_csv(sig_path)
effect_path <- ctx$paths$tables$diff_effect_size %||% file.path(job_dir, "tables", "diff_effect_size.csv")
effect_tbl <- safe_read_csv(effect_path)
consensus_path <- ctx$paths$tables$diff_consensus %||% file.path(job_dir, "tables", "diff_consensus.csv")
consensus_tbl <- safe_read_csv(consensus_path)
lefse_path <- ctx$paths$tables$diff_lefse %||% file.path(job_dir, "tables", "diff_lefse.csv")
lefse_tbl <- safe_read_csv(lefse_path)
ancombc_path <- ctx$paths$tables$diff_ancombc %||% file.path(job_dir, "tables", "diff_ancombc.csv")
ancombc_tbl <- safe_read_csv(ancombc_path)
if (!is.null(diff) && "taxon" %in% names(diff) && !"display_taxon" %in% names(diff)) diff$display_taxon <- display_taxon(diff$taxon)
if (!is.null(sig) && "taxon" %in% names(sig) && !"display_taxon" %in% names(sig)) sig$display_taxon <- display_taxon(sig$taxon)
```

```{r results='asis'}
if (is.list(diff_summary)) {
  n_sig <- diff_summary$n_significant_taxa %||% diff_summary$n_significant_fdr_0_05 %||% 0
  n_total <- diff_summary$n_total_taxa %||% diff_summary$n_total_taxa_tested %||% if (is.data.frame(diff)) nrow(diff) else 0
  n_trend <- diff_summary$n_trend_taxa %||% diff_summary$n_trend_fdr_0_1 %||% 0
  test_method <- diff_summary$test_method %||% diff_summary$method %||% "Wilcoxon/Kruskal-Wallis"
  cat(
    paste0(
      "Differential abundance at the **", diff_summary$tax_level %||% "selected taxonomic", "** level was evaluated across **",
      diff_summary$group_variable %||% "the selected group", "** using **", test_method, "** with BH/FDR correction."
    ),
    "\n"
  )
  if (n_sig > 0) {
    cat(paste0("Detected **", n_sig, "** FDR-significant taxa and **", n_trend, "** trend-level taxa out of **", n_total, "** tested taxa.\n"))
  } else {
    cat(paste0("No FDR-significant taxa were detected among **", n_total, "** tested taxa. Exploratory top taxa by raw p-value are shown below.\n"))
  }
}
```

## Key Taxa Hub

The Key Taxa Hub integrates multiple evidence sources to identify candidate key taxa.

```text
KeyTaxaScore =
0.35 x DifferentialScore +
0.30 x MLImportanceScore +
0.25 x NetworkCentralityScore +
0.10 x ConsensusScore

If a module result is missing, weights are automatically redistributed.
```

### Reliability Classification

- high_confidence: evidence_count >= 3
- moderate_confidence: evidence_count == 2
- exploratory: evidence_count == 1
- weak_evidence: evidence_count == 0

### Top Key Taxa Score Table

```{r}
kt_path <- ctx$paths$tables$key_taxa_score %||% file.path(job_dir, "tables", "key_taxa_score.csv")
kt <- safe_read_csv(kt_path)
if (!is.null(kt) && is.data.frame(kt) && nrow(kt) > 0) {
  show_cols <- intersect(
    c("display_taxon", "key_taxa_score", "reliability_label", "evidence_count", "evidence_methods",
      "differential_score", "ml_importance_score", "network_centrality_score", "consensus_score", "tax_level"),
    names(kt)
  )
  ord_cols <- intersect(c("key_taxa_score", "evidence_count"), names(kt))
  if (length(ord_cols) > 0) {
    kt_show <- kt[order(-kt$key_taxa_score, -kt$evidence_count, kt$taxon), , drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    kt_show <- kt
  }
  kt_show <- utils::head(kt_show, 20)
  knitr::kable(kt_show[, show_cols, drop = FALSE], caption = "Key Taxa Score (Top 20; multi-evidence)")
}
```
